response.sql: WITH site_mesh_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(sm.facetresmm / sm.geomdeltamm) AS site_avg_ratio FROM sites s INNER JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL AND sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL AND sm.geomdeltamm != 0 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_averages AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_mesh_ratios GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT smr.insurstat, AVG(smr.site_avg_ratio) AS above_average_sites_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS above_average_count, AVG(smr.site_avg_ratio - sa.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status FROM site_mesh_ratios smr INNER JOIN status_averages sa ON smr.insurstat = sa.insurstat WHERE smr.site_avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio GROUP BY smr.insurstat
